description:
Full-featured data grid with declarative column definitions, client-side and server-side data modes, sorting, inline column filters, global search, row selection with bulk actions, column visibility picker, drag-to-group with multi-level grouping, pagination with per-group mini-pager for server-side grouping, virtualized scrolling, external filter builder, and saved view management.\n\nComposition rule: either the owning page filters the data and the table renders a content-only surface (set ToolbarMode=ContentOnly and supply pre-filtered Items/DataProvider), or the table owns filtering via its own toolbar and external filter builder. Avoid enabling both filter surfaces at the same time unless they are explicitly integrated (e.g. the page reads the table's ActiveFilters).

Pagination test hooks: the paging footer carries data-testid="pagination-container" and the table's own item-range text "pagination-summary"; the embedded TmPagination contributes "pagination", "pagination-info", "pagination-prev", "pagination-next", "pagination-page-{n}" and "pagination-page-size". TestIdPrefix set on the table is propagated into the embedded pagination, so two tables on one page do not collide. Use PaginationAttributes for non-test attributes on the pagination root and PaginationInfoTemplate (context: DataTablePaginationInfo) to replace the built-in "showing X-Y of Z" wording. Exactly one item-range label is rendered: PaginationInfoPlacement picks between the table summary ("pagination-summary", the default) and the pagination bar's own label ("pagination-info"), or None for neither, so only the id of the chosen placement exists in the DOM.

Methods (via @ref): ResetPageAsync() returns the table to the first page and reloads. Call it whenever the host narrows the result set itself (its own search or filter). The table does not reset the page on an Items change — it only clamps the current page down to the new last page — so without this call a search performed while on page 3 leaves the user on page 3. It is not automatic by design: a table re-polling the same list on a timer would otherwise yank a reading user back to page 1 on every refresh.

Accessibility: a sortable column header is keyboard operable — it is a focus stop (tabindex="0") and responds to Enter and Space, with Shift for multi-sort, mirroring Shift+click. Non-sortable headers are not focus stops.
compositionGuidance: Either the page filters the data, or the table filters the data. When the page owns the filters, use ToolbarMode=ContentOnly and do not set ViewProvider/ExternalFilterDefinitions. When the table owns the filters, use the default Full toolbar mode and optionally a ViewProvider.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: In-memory items. When set without DataProvider, client-side sort/filter/pagination applies.

parameters.name: DataProvider
parameters.description: Server-side data provider. When set, overrides Items and calls GetDataAsync on query changes.

parameters.name: IsLoading
parameters.description: When true, shows a loading spinner instead of rows. Useful for manual loading control.

parameters.name: EmptyTitle
parameters.description: Heading shown in the empty state when no items are available.

parameters.name: Selectable
parameters.description: Enables row checkboxes for multi-select.

parameters.name: ShowSearch
parameters.description: When true, shows the global search input. Default: true.

parameters.name: SearchText
parameters.description: Controlled search text. When set, the component uses this value instead of its internal state.

parameters.name: SearchTextChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the search text changes.

parameters.name: ShowColumnPicker
parameters.description: When true, shows the column visibility picker. Default: true.

parameters.name: ShowPagination
parameters.description: When true, shows the TmPagination bar when more than one page exists. Default: true. When false, a client-side table (Items) renders every item it was handed rather than the first page — the pager is the only element that reaches pages 2..N, so hiding it and still slicing would leave the remaining rows in no element at all. Server-side paging through DataProvider is unaffected: there the page is chosen by the provider.

parameters.name: ShowToolbar
parameters.description: When true, renders the toolbar container with search, column picker, and view manager. Default: true. The toolbar is not rendered when no visible control would be shown (see ToolbarMode). For a page-owned filter surface, set ToolbarMode to ContentOnly and supply filtered data via Items or DataProvider.

parameters.name: ToolbarMode
parameters.description: High-level preset that controls which toolbar chrome elements are rendered. Full respects the individual Show* booleans; other modes override them.

parameters.name: ShowViewManager
parameters.description: When true and a ViewProvider is set, renders the TmViewManager. Default: true.

parameters.name: DefaultPageSize
parameters.description: Initial page size. Default: 25.

parameters.name: DefaultSortColumn
parameters.description: Key of the column the table is sorted by on first render, before the user clicks any header. The key is the column's PropertyName, falling back to its Title. Null (default) starts unsorted, in the order the items were supplied. Seeded before the first load, so a server-side DataProvider receives it in its very first query. Clicking cycles on from it normally (from Ascending, the first click on that column sorts descending and the second clears the sort); applying a saved view replaces it; an unknown key leaves the table unsorted. The column need not be Sortable — a non-sortable column still orders the data, which is how you express a fixed order the user cannot change.

parameters.name: DefaultSortDirection
parameters.description: Direction applied to DefaultSortColumn; ignored when that is null. Values: Ascending (default), Descending.

parameters.name: PageSizeOptions
parameters.description: Page size options shown in the pagination dropdown.

parameters.name: PaginationInfoPlacement
parameters.description: Which of the two item-range labels in the paging footer is rendered, so the count is not printed twice. Summary (default) uses the table's own summary on the left of the footer, which is the placement that honours PaginationInfoTemplate; Pagination moves the range into the TmPagination bar itself; None shows page controls only.

parameters.name: ViewProvider
parameters.description: Optional view persistence provider. When set, enables saved views and (by default) the external filter builder. Use ShowExternalFilterBuilder = false to keep saved views without rendering the inline filter builder, or ToolbarMode = ContentOnly when the page owns the filtering UI.

parameters.name: ViewFilterDefinitions
parameters.description: Filter definitions used by the view manager filter builder when creating or editing saved views.

parameters.name: ShowExternalFilterBuilder
parameters.description: When true and a ViewProvider is set, shows the inline FilterBuilder for external filtering. Default: true. Set to false when the surrounding page owns the filtering UI to avoid duplicate filters.

parameters.name: ExternalFilterDefinitions
parameters.description: Filter definitions for the inline external filter builder (shown above the table when ViewProvider is set). When the page owns filtering, leave this empty and set ShowExternalFilterBuilder to false or use ToolbarMode = ContentOnly.

parameters.name: ViewCanCreateTenantViews
parameters.description: Whether the user can create tenant-wide views. Default: false.

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Current user ID for personal view scoping.

parameters.name: CurrentTenantId
parameters.description: Current tenant ID for tenant view scoping.

parameters.name: ViewContext
parameters.description: Unique identifier for this table instance. Used to scope saved views to specific tables (e.g., "employees", "projects").

parameters.name: ScrollMode
parameters.description: Scroll/pagination mode. Default: Pagination.

parameters.name: VirtualItemSize
parameters.description: Height of a single row in pixels (required for Virtualize). Default: 48.

parameters.name: VirtualOverscanCount
parameters.description: Number of extra items to render above/below viewport. Default: 3.

parameters.name: VirtualScrollHeight
parameters.description: Fixed height for the virtualized scroll container (e.g. "600px", "80vh").

parameters.name: ShowGrouping
parameters.description: Whether to show the grouping drop zone above the table.

parameters.name: GroupsCollapsedByDefault
parameters.description: Whether groups are collapsed by default.

parameters.name: OnRowClick
parameters.description: Fires when a data row is clicked.

parameters.name: OnSelectionChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the selection changes.

parameters.name: OnGroupingChanged
parameters.description: Fires when grouping configuration changes.

parameters.name: RowAttributes
parameters.description: Optional row-level HTML attributes applied to every data row, including non-virtualized, virtualized, and grouped leaf rows.

parameters.name: SelectionActions
parameters.description: Render fragment shown in the selection action bar (bulk actions).

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the wrapper div.

usedAbstractions.name: IDataTableDataProvider<TItem>
usedAbstractions.description: Server-side data provider for fetching paginated, sorted, and filtered data

usedAbstractions.name: DataTableQuery
usedAbstractions.description: Query parameters passed to the data provider (pagination, sorting, filtering)

usedAbstractions.name: PagedResult<TItem>
usedAbstractions.description: Result returned by the data provider

usedAbstractions.name: FilterDefinition
usedAbstractions.description: Individual filter condition used in DataTableQuery.Filters

usedAbstractions.name: DataTableView
usedAbstractions.description: Saved view configuration for column visibility, sorting, and filters

examples.title: Basic data table with columns
examples.code:
<TmDataTable TItem="Employee" Items="@employees" ViewContext="employees">
    <TmDataTableColumn Title="Name" Field="e => e.Name" Sortable="true" Filterable="true" />
    <TmDataTableColumn Title="Department" Field="e => e.Department" Sortable="true" Groupable="true" />
    <TmDataTableColumn Title="Salary" Field="e => e.Salary" Sortable="true" Align="ColumnAlign.Right" Width="120px" />
    <TmDataTableColumn Title="Actions" Hideable="false">
        <CellTemplate Context="emp">
            <button @onclick="() => Edit(emp)">Edit</button>
        </CellTemplate>
    </TmDataTableColumn>
</TmDataTable>

examples.title: Server-side data table with selection and views
examples.code:
<TmDataTable TItem="OrderDto"
             DataProvider="@orderProvider"
             ViewContext="orders"
             ViewProvider="@viewProvider"
             Selectable="true"
             ShowGrouping="true"
             OnRowClick="HandleRowClick"
             OnSelectionChanged="HandleSelectionChanged">
    <SelectionActions>
        <TmButton OnClick="DeleteSelected">Delete</TmButton>
    </SelectionActions>
    <TmDataTableColumn Title="Order #" Field="o => o.OrderNumber" Sortable="true" />
    <TmDataTableColumn Title="Status" Field="o => o.Status" Filterable="true" FilterType="FilterType.Select" FilterOptions="@statusOptions" />
</TmDataTable>

examples.title: Row-level attributes for test ids and data hooks
examples.code:
<TmDataTable TItem="OrderDto"
             Items="@orders"
             ViewContext="orders"
             RowAttributes="@(row => new Dictionary<string, object>
             {
                 ["data-testid"] = $"order-{row.Id}",
                 ["data-status"] = row.Status
             })">
    <TmDataTableColumn Title="Order #" Field="o => o.OrderNumber" />
    <TmDataTableColumn Title="Status" Field="o => o.Status" />
</TmDataTable>

examples.title: Page-owned filters + content-only table
Saved views without external filter builder
examples.code:
@using Tempo.Blazor.Components.DataTable
@using Tempo.Blazor.Interfaces
@using Tempo.Blazor.Models

@* Use the view manager for saved views, but keep the inline filter builder hidden. *@
<TmDataTable TItem="EmployeeDto"
             DataProvider="@_dataProvider"
             ViewContext="employees-saved-views"
             ViewProvider="@_viewProvider"
             ViewFilterDefinitions="@_viewFilterDefs"
             ShowExternalFilterBuilder="false"
             ShowSearch="false">
    <TmDataTableColumn TItem="EmployeeDto" Title="Name" PropertyName="Name" Sortable="true" Field="e => e.Name" />
    <TmDataTableColumn TItem="EmployeeDto" Title="Role" PropertyName="Role" Sortable="true" Field="e => e.Role" />
</TmDataTable>
